name: Ougi Kanae
source:
Grade: High school 1st year student
Ability: Perfect Gravity (allows Kanae to completely manipulate the gravity)Precise height: 144.4 cm

The very small heroine who is violent, selfish, possessive about anything she likes and naive. However, she possesses huge amount of potential and power, and is considered the academy's most powerful student, despite being a first-year. She is paired up with [url=/c36958]Ayumu[/url] against her will, but learns to tolerate him.
